answer_1.quote: We introduce the Russian Corpus of Linguistic Acceptability (RuCoLA)... The out-of-domain sentences are produced by nine open-source MT and paraphrase generation models... The out-of-domain set... to foster text generation evaluation with acceptability.
answer_1.outputs: Machine‑translated and paraphrased Russian sentences generated by the listed models, which are later judged for linguistic acceptability.

answer_2.quote: We obtain the PenLP measure for each sentence by computing its log‑probability ... from the ruGPT3-medium model. PenLP normalizes the log‑probability ... to predict acceptability.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on the entire in‑domain test set and 50% of the out‑of‑domain test set... The pay rate is on average $6.3/hr, and the task design is similar to Stage 1... annotators are undergraduate BA and MA students in philology and linguistics.
